title: Account briefing & renewal slate - deck templates (standard + enterprise)
content:
Purpose: single-file source-of-truth with two opinionated slide sequences (Standard / Enterprise) + a lightweight renewal tracker and a short playbook for running the meeting and post-QBR follow-up. Use for customer-facing QBRs and as a starting point for AE + CSM collaboration.

Quick notes (working):
- This is intentionally concise: pick the slide set that matches the customer tier.
- Keep speaker notes short; allow CSM to inject account-specific highlights (customer wins, blockers).
- Audience: Product/Engineering guests for enterprise QBRs only (invite based on open risks or roadmap asks).
- Timebox total meeting time: 45–60m for standard; 60–90m for enterprise.

HOW TO USE
- Duplicate this deck, rename to [Customer]-QBR-[YYYY-MM-DD].
- Run through the deck in a 20–30m rehearsal with AE to align on ask + CTA.
- For renewals: append a 5-slide renewal appendix with contract details and options.

STANDARD QBR (35–45m) — audience: CSM + AE + productlight
1) Cover / Greeting (2m)
   - Title, date, attendees, desired outcomes: (1) align on health, (2) prioritize next 90 days, (3) confirm renewal runway
   - Speaker note: quick intro + 15s thank you for partnership
2) Executive snapshot (3m)
   - 3 metrics: adoption (active routes / daily users), value metric (e.g., inference spend showing cost-per-call curve), reliability (p95 latency or error rate)
   - Traffic sparkline month-over-month
3) Health summary (5m)
   - Green / Yellow / Red with 1-sentence rationale each.
4) Usage & adoption highlights (6m)
   - Top 3 successful workflows, notable upticks, customer quote or customer success story snippet.
   - Speaker note: call out product features enabling value (e.g., caching improved latency by X%)
5) Risks & blockers (6m)
   - Open issues, integration gaps, performance outliers.
   - Owner + ETA for each item.
6) Roadmap alignment (6m)
   - Short list of upcoming feature releases that map to customer goals.
   - Ask: which of these should we prioritize for your workspace?
7) Success plan / next steps (5m)
   - 90-day plan: outcomes, owners, measurable signals.
8) Renewal preview & commercial CTA (2m)
   - High-level renewal status and next steps (AE to own pricing discussion offline).
9) AOB + close (1–2m)

ENTERPRISE QBR (60–90m) — audience: CSM + AE + Product + SRE + Security (as needed)
1) Cover / framing (3m)
   - Include deck index, goals, SLAs under review, and any legal/compliance items to raise.
2) Executive health + business outcome tie (6m)
   - Translate product metrics into business KPIs (e.g., time-to-insight reduced by X, revenue enablement).
3) Deep dive: performance & reliability (10–15m)
   - P50/P95/P99 latency, error types, incidents (post-mortem summaries), capacity planning.
   - SRE speaker note: include planned mitigations and expected impact.
4) Security & compliance snapshot (8–12m)
   - Audit trails, encryption/KMS status, SOC/ISO/RoC updates, outstanding compliance items.
5) Adoption & integrations (10m)
   - API usage patterns, embedding adoption, notable integrations, roadmap dependencies.
6) Risk register (10m)
   - Score-based risk matrix (impact x likelihood), mitigation plan, owners.
7) Partnership roadmap (10m)
   - Co-development opportunities, pilot proposals, timelines, and escalation path.
8) Commercial & renewal deep-dive (8–10m)
   - Renewal scenarios, usage growth projections, contract options, and proposed timelines.
9) Action plan & working session (10–15m)
   - Capture commitments, owners, due dates, and success metrics.

Slide templates & speaker note examples (copy/paste):
- "Executive snapshot" slide (speaker note): "Start with 30s summary: health (green), top value signal (X), and one risk. Then ask: do these align with exec priorities?"
- "Risk register" slide fields: id | title | owner | current_score (1-9) | mitigation | eta.
- "90-day success plan" slide: goal | metric | owner | checkpoints (30/60/90).

Renewal tracker (lightweight sheet represented here as bullets — paste into sheet if needed):
- Columns (suggested): customer_name, renewal_date, contract_value, ARR_current, ARR_proj_12m, renewal_owner, renewal_stage (discovery|proposal|negotiation|closed-won|closed-lost), exec_sponsor_status, risk_score (1-10), next_action, next_action_date, linked_doc
- Example row (text): "Acme Corp | 2025-01-30 | $240k | $240k | $320k | Marco Ruiz | negotiation | sponsored | 6 | propose tiered pricing | 2024-12-05 | docs/Acme-Renewal-OptionA.pdf"
- Quick rules: 1) update the tracker at EOD after any AE/CSM touchpoint; 2) flag any row with risk_score >= 7 for immediate leadership sync.

Renewal conversation playbook (cheat sheet)
Pre-meeting (AE + CSM)
- Run usage + spend snapshot (last 90 days), prepare 1–2 customer wins, identify 2 negotiables (pricing, term) and 1 non-negotiable (SLA).
- Stakeholder map: who signs, who evaluates tech, who controls budget.
During meeting
- Confirm success metrics, present usage trends, propose renewal scenarios (conservative, committed, growth), capture immediate objections, align on timeline.
Post-meeting
- Send summarized minutes <24h with clear ask and next-step owner/due date.
- If negotiation starts, AE to share commercial slides + T&C checklist; CSM to provide adoption and technical appendix.

Customization variables (copy into deck before sending):
- [CUSTOMER_NAME], [QUARTER], [RENEWAL_DATE], [CURRENT_ARR], [PROJECTED_ARR], [TOP_3_FEATURES], [OPEN_ISSUES_COUNT], [NEXT_MEETING_DATE]

Common objections & suggested talk tracks (CSM + AE aligned):
- "Cost too high" -> "Show unit-economics improvements tied to batching/kv-cache recommendations; present step plan to reduce token spend if needed."
- "Missing feature X" -> "Confirm roadmap timing or propose temporary workaround + hold weekly SWAT until resolved."
- "Security concerns" -> "Offer architecture review with our security lead and provide SOC artifacts in 48h."

Appendix: templates for follow-up emails
- 24h summary email snippet: "Thanks again — attached the deck. Agreed next steps: 1) AE to share pricing options by DATE; 2) CSM to schedule architecture review by DATE. Please confirm owners.
- Escalation template: short paragraph with ask for exec sponsorship if renewal risk_score >= 8.

TODOs / open questions (notes to self)
- Add a pre-built table for common pricing scenarios (3 options) — Marco + Finance to finalize numbers.
- Confirm template for privacy artifacts link (Evelyn to check legal).
- Consider a one-pager for execs: 1-slide success story + 1-slide ask (for renewals > $500k).

Version history (working):
- v0.1 2024-11-15 A.Patel initial draft
- v0.2 2024-11-22 M.Ruiz added enterprise deep-dive sections
- v0.3 2024-12-02 E.Chen added security/compliance checklist

Links / refs
- Confluence: CS-QBR-Framework-v2 (use for scoring rubric)
- Sheet: renewal-tracker-master (canonical tracker)
- Slack: #cs-qbr for async comments

Notes to presenters: keep slides visually light, one main chart per slide, and use appendix for backup data. If a slide triggers a long technical discussion: table it and open a short follow-up workshop with product/SRE rather than extending the QBR beyond scheduled time.

End of doc.
